info.title: Magical Destroyers
info.synopsis: La serie è ambientata in un futuro distopico in cui la cultura otaku in Giappone è stata cancellata da una misteriosa organizzazione nota come "SSC". La trama segue le disavventure di Otaku Hero, un giovane rivoluzionario che ama la cultura otaku, e Anarchy, Blue e Pink, un trio di ragazze magiche che lo ammirano. Insieme lottano per creare "un mondo in cui puoi dire e fare quello che ti piace senza pregiudizi o proibizioni".

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: 2011. Otaku culture has been eliminated in Japan. A resistance army hides in Akiba. When leader Otaku Hero loses the will to fight, comrade Magical Girl Anarchy relights his fire. The army then moves to liberate the otaku prison camp at Tokyo Big Sight.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: 2011. Otaku culture has been eliminated in Japan. A resistance army hides in Akiba. When leader Otaku Hero loses the will to fight, comrade Magical Girl Anarchy relights his fire. The army then moves to liberate the otaku prison camp at Tokyo Big Sight.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: Otaku Hero, Anarchy, and Blue get a lead on Pink's whereabouts from super hacker Nick. The group heads to Pink's hideout to try to get her to join forces with them.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: Otaku Hero, Anarchy, and Blue get a lead on Pink's whereabouts from super hacker Nick. The group heads to Pink's hideout to try to get her to join forces with them.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: Joined by Pink, the three Magical Girls are now reunited. While Otaku Hero and the girls hold a rally at a maid café in Akihabara, one of SSC's Four Heavenly Kings launches a giant robot to face them in battle. What is behind Unit-@'s hatred of otaku?

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: After Otaku Hero loses a beloved toy robot in the Kanda River, he and the girls are confronted by the hostile middle-aged members of the Mansei Bridge Otaku Commune. The two generations enter a contest to fight over the true definition of otaku culture.

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: After Otaku Hero loses a beloved toy robot in the Kanda River, he and the girls are confronted by the hostile middle-aged members of the Mansei Bridge Otaku Commune. The two generations enter a contest to fight over the true definition of otaku culture.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Otaku Hero takes the girls behind enemy lines in Shibuya to find an elderly collector with a drug that amplifies magical powers. The collector agrees to provide the drug in exchange for a rare figurine set locked away in the SSC base at Nakano Sunplaza.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: Otaku Hero takes the girls behind enemy lines in Shibuya to find an elderly collector with a drug that amplifies magical powers. The collector agrees to provide the drug in exchange for a rare figurine set locked away in the SSC base at Nakano Sunplaza.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: With Otaku Hero and the girls in Nakano, SSC launches an attack on the Akiba Liberated Zone. The other otaku struggle to defend their base. On the way back to Akiba, Otaku Hero recalls his past with the magical girls and his first encounter with Shobon.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: With Otaku Hero and the girls in Nakano, SSC launches an attack on the Akiba Liberated Zone. The other otaku struggle to defend their base. On the way back to Akiba, Otaku Hero recalls his past with the magical girls and his first encounter with Shobon.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: On their way back to Akiba, Otaku Hero and the girls are confronted by two of SSC’s Four Heavenly Kings—Adam and Eve. They get trapped in a cyberspace where Otaku Hero and Anarchy must defend against relentless attacks and cheats to rescue Blue and Pink.

tmdb.title: Episodio 7
tmdb.synopsis: On their way back to Akiba, Otaku Hero and the girls are confronted by two of SSC’s Four Heavenly Kings—Adam and Eve. They get trapped in a cyberspace where Otaku Hero and Anarchy must defend against relentless attacks and cheats to rescue Blue and Pink.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Otaku Hero, Nick, and the other otakus get together to discuss the planning for the upcoming Wanku event. From merch, to guests, and even a possible physical media release, it's all on the shoulders of the appointed lead producer, Otaku Hero.

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: Otaku Hero, Nick, and the other otakus get together to discuss the planning for the upcoming Wanku event. From merch, to guests, and even a possible physical media release, it's all on the shoulders of the appointed lead producer, Otaku Hero.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: SSC forces attack the otaku at the Wanku! event with an army led by two of the Four Heavenly Kings—the silent Himawari and her overbearing older brother. Pink and Blue have to take the power-up drugs from Chogo-shi to defend against the deadly siblings.

tmdb.title: Episodio 9
tmdb.synopsis: SSC forces attack the otaku at the Wanku! event with an army led by two of the Four Heavenly Kings—the silent Himawari and her overbearing older brother. Pink and Blue have to take the power-up drugs from Chogo-shi to defend against the deadly siblings.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: With the thought of Anarchy's return casting a shadow over the otaku army, Otaku Hero rallies the troops and prepares for one final battle. Otaku Hero leads a direct attack on SSC headquarters while the magical girls stay to defend Akiba from Slayer.

tmdb.title: Episodio 10
tmdb.synopsis: With the thought of Anarchy's return casting a shadow over the otaku army, Otaku Hero rallies the troops and prepares for one final battle. Otaku Hero leads a direct attack on SSC headquarters while the magical girls stay to defend Akiba from Slayer.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: The notebook that Otaku Hero found in the SSC base explains the origin of Shobon's hatred for otaku and foreshadows a dangerous fate for the magical girls. Running through the empty streets of Tokyo, Otaku Hero races back to try to change the script.

tmdb.title: Episodio 11
tmdb.synopsis: The notebook that Otaku Hero found in the SSC base explains the origin of Shobon's hatred for otaku and foreshadows a dangerous fate for the magical girls. Running through the empty streets of Tokyo, Otaku Hero races back to try to change the script.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: Once Slayer's blood transforms the magical girls into Magical Destroyers, Shobon moves his story toward its planned climax. There is little Otaku Hero can do to resist. What will be the fate of the otaku army and otaku culture in SSC's planned New World?
